track.why: Logged route is West Ridge; the report describes the Terror creek crossings, Chopping Block saddle camp, the snow gully to the notch, a 30 m low-fifth pitch, class 2-3 ridge, false summit and exposed step to the true summit, which matches our text. Round trip from the Goodell Creek trailhead (start and end 14 m apart, 473 m from our stored West Ridge pin but within 30 m of the Goodell Creek Trailhead pin stored on the East Ridge route), summit within 48 m. Mechanical flags say incomplete only because our West Ridge pin (Upper Goodell Group Camp, 48.68664,-121.27121) sits about 470 m from where every recording starts; I could not confirm a better coordinate from a fetched page, so no pin move is proposed.

facts.text: ice axe and crampons (mid-June to mid-July: unbroken snow from about 4,800 ft to the saddle and up the gully)
In mid-June the creek crossings on the approach run high and the Terror Creek log can be partly submerged; budget time to scout a crossing.
The rappel slings on the upper ridge looked worn in June; carry spare cord to back them up.
In mid-June the gully held firm snow nearly to the notch with no moats yet, but the lower snow went to soft slush over hard ice by the return, forcing a facing-in downclimb.
In early July loose rock on the scramble and descent has knocked climbers off their feet; stay out of the fall line below your partners.

notes: West Ridge track fails the 300 m start rule only because the stored West Ridge/Stoddard trailhead pin (Upper Goodell Group Camp, 48.68664,-121.27121) is about 470 m from the Goodell Creek Trailhead pin stored on the East Ridge route (48.6828,-121.2693), where every recording starts. Nominatim, WTA and a web search returned no coordinate for it, so no pin change is proposed; the owner may want to reconcile the two. The East Ridge route's id is southeast_face and its text describes the East Ridge from Crescent Creek Basin. allRoutesOnPeak also holds North Face / North Buttress, which the packet does not need a track for.
